info.name: Healthcare Backend API
info.description:
# PH Healthcare System - Complete Backend API Collection

Live URL: `https://healthcare-backend-omega-five.vercel.app/api/v1`
Local URL: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

### Features:
- **Automated Token Management**: Logging in as Patient, Doctor, Admin, or Super Admin automatically saves tokens to collection variables (`patientToken`, `doctorToken`, `adminToken`, `superAdminToken`).
- **Auto-captured IDs**: Creating schedules, fetching doctors, booking appointments, and fetching payments automatically capture `doctorId`, `scheduleId`, `appointmentId`, and `paymentId`.
- **Dynamic Schedule Generator**: `Create Schedule` pre-request script generates valid dates for **today** (1 hour ahead) so appointment booking succeeds without time-window errors.
- **Full Coverage**: Includes Auth, User, Doctor, Schedule, Appointment, Payment, Prescription, and Analytics endpoints.
